name: memo-bridge
description: Private, read-only MCP for Memo Labs: one interface to inspect a Mac and a Netcup VPS without relying on the Sentinel X commercial hub.

interface.longDescription: Inspect the status of the Memo Labs Mac and VPS from one MCP, using only fixed read-only probes. Requires a local Mac runtime and SSH access to the VPS.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the status of my Mac and VPS through Memo Bridge.
